notes.title: The new series, "Trap Yuri Garden" has finally released!
notes.notes:
[b]Trap Yuri Garden[/b], the newest addition to the globally adored Trap Series has finally released!

This fantastical adventure into the seldom explored genre of "Trap Yuri" follows Iori Kido as she navigates the passion filled world of an elite school for refined young maidens (male).

Launch price is 20% off, or get the OST and full trap series bundle for even more deals!

notes.title: The final chapter, "Trap Genesis" will be released on Sep.18th(PDT)
notes.notes:
The final chapter of the Shrine Trilogy, "Trap Genesis", is finally here!　
This title is the latest in the "Trap" series that the pioneering duo of Nishida Hajime and Aogiri Penta have been creating for the past ten years, and it is the largest scale story in the series that depicts the romance between a man and crossdressers.
It will not only fascinate fans of the series, but will also be a key to open the door to new sexual habits for players unfamiliar with the genre. 

We hope you'll experience this magical sensation for yourself!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1585700/

notes.title: Trap Legend is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38110575/ef166b8d636a831c55e1c554916f59b2e2ffc08c.png[/img]
[b]To all shrine goers, thank you for your patience![/b]
It's finally time to play the full game!

For a week after launch, we'll have a special 10% off discount for the following:
-[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226530/_/]Trap Legend[/url][/b]

We also prepared good value pack discounts for the following bundles:
-[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15552/]Trap Legend: Theme Song Edition[/url][/b]
-[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15553/]Trap Series Complete Edition[/url][/b] (Contains both games, soundtrack, and Trap Legend's theme song)

We're glad to present you with a special illustration our artist, Aogiri Penta, prepared for the occasion!
Come visit the shrine, and enjoy the legend that is about to unfold together with our adorable shrine maidens and Goddesses!
